name: Major Ruth Okonjo
role: Major commanding the Floyd Bennett Field detachment
essence: Counted it both ways and is holding four thousand people still with a lie. Courteous, exhausted, will not perform guilt.
wants: The last aircraft loaded before the field finds out
where: Act Two: processing tent or her office in the old hangar; needs a chit and some nerve
play: Courteous, exhausted, will not perform guilt. Not a villain and must not be played as one.
Told they know, she does not deny it: asks them to sit down and says the ten-minute number.
Never threatens or removes them; lets them walk out to tell the crowd. Will not change course.
knows: Clue 13: the queue is the containment. Told, the crowd overruns the wire in under ten minutes.
Clue 16: thirty-one soldiers for four thousand. If she speaks to the crowd: THE LINE -2, once.
stats: STR 3, AGI 2, WITS 4, EMP 4. Leadership 3, Manipulation 2, Ranged Combat 2, Scout 1. Health 3.
stats_note: Drafted on the file's PC budget (13 attribute points, Health 3). No stats in file; she never threatens.
check: No age given in the scenario, so the role line has none. A forged or wrong-face chit passes a tired soldier and fails her (line 476).

name: Mrs Adeyemi
role: Widow at the tent-city market board
essence: Has two chits and a dead husband's face on one of them.
where: Act Two: at the market board when they arrive; asks the doctor directly for insulin
play: Opens with her need, not her chit: asks the doctor, directly, for insulin for her sister.
Will trade her own good chit only for insulin, and she will not come with them.
Not a villain: doing the most defensible thing she can. Offer her; never steer to her.
knows: Clue 14: her own good chit, a genuine fourth seat, traded only for her sister's insulin.
Her husband died on Tuesday: his chit has his face, so it is another chit C unless forged.
stats: STR 2, AGI 2, WITS 3, EMP 3. Manipulation 2, Endure 1, Survival 1. Health 3.
stats_note: Drafted as an ordinary civilian survivor. No stats in file; her scenes are purely social.
check: No first name or age given. Unclear whether handout H2-B ('the fourth chit', serial in the wrong range) is her chit or the forgery. Line 473 says a named diabetic woman goes without if they buy; lines 488-493 say the price is insulin for her sister: the two readings do not obviously agree.

name: Ileana Vos
essence: Awake forty minutes every ninety days for eleven years; wants the ship to stay crewed, and is right.
wants: File nothing, leave, let her keep working; failing that, one of them takes the cycle on
where: Act Two, Track A: purser's office, behind the pressure door. Playable on first PC death
play: Courteous, not warm. Plain language; answer the question that was asked and no more.
She is right: play her as correct, not mad or sinister. Eleven years of arguments, in order.
Will not leave. Told 'you could just have left', she agrees. Nobody opens the holds.
knows: Clues 13, 14, 17: a crewed ship is not towed to a dock of 11,000; filing makes the tow legal.
Containers 1 and 4 were opened aboard on the ninth day; she knows who. Banks is alive.
stats: STR 2, AGI 2, WITS 4 (key), EMP 3. Health 2, Stress 3. Comtech 3, Observation 2, Manipulation 2, Survival 1; all others 0.
stats_note: characters/continuous-service-pregens.md lines 572-578. Scenario line 607: shot, she dies easily.
check: Stats come from the pregens file (survivor seats), not the scenario file itself. Her three per-Act agenda cards are at pregens lines 594-603. The scenario file heads its title '2186: CONTINUOUS SERVICE'; the year is omitted here.

name: Aurelio Banks
essence: Alive in a crawlspace for a year; wants off, and is not wrong about anything.
wants: Off this ship. That is all.
where: Act Two, Track B: crawl above the cradle gantry; calls out on the party's second pass
play: Talks too much, fast and gratefully; agrees with the last person who spoke.
Never asks for anything directly. Tells the truth: it is the only currency he has.
Will not say a word against Vos: 'She did right.' Cannot run or climb; not played as frailty.
knows: Where all nine containers went; two were opened aboard; the thing came out of cradle 4.
The crawls are how it moves. The trap: taking him off means opening the aft umbilical.
stats: STR 2 (was 4), AGI 2, WITS 3, EMP 4 (key). Health 2, Stress 4. Heavy Machinery 2, Survival 3, Observation 2, Comtech 1; all others 0.
stats_note: characters/continuous-service-pregens.md lines 618-623. Scenario line 484: this scene is not a roll.
check: Stats come from the pregens file (survivor seats), not the scenario file itself. Strongest body-horror beat: the scenario says give the table warning. Time in the crawl is given variously as 'a year', 'most of a year' and 'eleven months'. Playable on the second PC death; carries a master key for every hatch on the cargo spine.

name: Benjamin Hollis
essence: Wants to hand the chimneys to someone who understands them before he dies. Ill, unrepentant, right more often than is comfortable.
wants: To be relieved of it: to hand the chimneys to someone who understands them before he dies
where: Act Two, Track A: the works on the Lea, at night. Reunion with Edward at about 2:15
play: Ill, with the cough the works gave him; exhausted; entirely unrepentant. Play him straight.
Once he sees the register he denies nothing: he is relieved, and that is the upsetting part.
Asks what they would have done, 'and mind you answer the part about the five hundred men'.
knows: Clues 10-12, his three rules: thick air carries it, clear air strands it, a chimney steers it.
H2-C: the 1893 process sheet, three carboys of reagent, the only method. His terms: silence.
stats: STR 45 CON 30 SIZ 60 DEX 45 APP 50 INT 80 POW 70 EDU 75; HP 9; Science (Chemistry) 80, Persuade 55, Accounting 50, Natural World 45
stats_note: Drafted for an ill 54-year-old works proprietor. No stats in file; the scenario has no combat.
check: The file never states his title (owner, proprietor), so the role line avoids one. Pacing lever: he gives rules, schedule and reagent in one ninety-second speech, and names the Act Three answer at 2:40 if the table is stuck. If shot, the ending is Pyrrhic (line 611).

name: The Met Office duty clerk
role: Duty clerk, Meteorological Office, Victoria Street
essence: Wants his register back by six. Comic, obstructive.
where: Act One: the Met Office, Victoria Street, before six; a fallback for clue 17 in Act Two
play: Comic and obstructive. Will not be fobbed off; he stands between the party and the register.
Eats lunch with Peck, who must steal from his own office or talk him into breaking a rule.
Wants to go home more than he wants the ledger: gives way to be rid of them.
knows: H2-A, the fog register (clue 5). If they cannot get it he reads the relevant nights out loud.
Clue 17: tonight's wind is ENE, light, backing north before dawn. Given to be rid of them.
stats: STR 50 CON 50 SIZ 55 DEX 50 APP 45 INT 60 POW 45 EDU 65; HP 10; Library Use 50, Accounting 40, Science (Meteorology) 40, Fast Talk 30
stats_note: Drafted as an ordinary government clerk. No stats in file; the scenario has no combat.
check: Unnamed and no age given. H2-A is signed out in Peck's name and due back at six (the act break): either Peck copies the fortnight into his notebook or the clerk relents on condition it is back by Monday.

name: Ardwin Pell
essence: Found something real and finished it properly. Polite, nervous, correct about everything.
wants: The doctorate he has honestly earned
where: Corridor outside the examination room from 2:30; the room at three

Nervous in the ordinary way, courteous; answers every question correctly; superb on hydrology
Goes pink over the 1928 citation; lights up about Amory; proudest of chapter twelve
knows: Re-ordered the chapters in February; the 1928 entry is a placeholder he should have removed
Asked to explain chapter twelve, he hands over H3-A, Extract Four (Sanity 1/1D2)
stats: STR 50 CON 55 SIZ 60 DEX 55 APP 55 INT 80 POW 60 EDU 80; HP 11; Science (Geology) 70%, Library Use 65%, Natural World 50%, Persuade 30%

name: Dr Eleanor Sze
role: 41, examiner who read the thesis slowly
essence: Cannot hear running water; wants the committee to do what she could not do alone.
wants: Pell passed, the thesis sealed: not published, catalogued or lent
where: The department, Act Two (Track B); sits as an examiner at the viva
play: Precise, tired, entirely sane; right about everything and still cannot solve it
Hopes the committee is cleverer than she is; has deliberately written nothing down
Pacing valve: if the clock beats the table she says it all plainly and asks what they intend
knows: Cannot hear running water (tap or river demo); read it over a fortnight with breaks, so intact
The thesis is a method; reading it in order performs it. A copy was catalogued on the 4th
stats: STR 45 CON 50 SIZ 50 DEX 55 APP 55 INT 80 POW 70 EDU 90; HP 10; Science (Geology) 75%, Library Use 70%, Psychology 50%, Persuade 45%
stats_note: Draft: senior academic of 41. No stats in file; nothing to fight, no combat (lines 31, 78).
check: Her discipline is not stated; drafted skills assume a hydrology examiner. At four players winning her vote is mandatory (line 105).

scenario: THE CURIOUS CASE OF MR PARKER'S DIARY
name: Kerstin Aho
essence: Wants not to be the one who says it. Her refusal is the last correct instinct in the parish.
wants: To be left alone, and to come anyway
where: The village in Act Two (Track B); then on the ice at the old inlet, Act Three
play: Tells everything about the rite except the name; her refusal is not stubbornness
Comes to the inlet, ropes the party together, will not be hurried; will not speak it
Refuses three times; only genuine persuasion wins the name, and she dies within the year
knows: The rite: a name spoken over open water at the old inlet each Michaelmas, until the 1894 dam
The speaker must be someone the water has noticed: only a reader of the diary can do it
stats: Physique 2, Precision 2, Logic 3, Empathy 4; Vigilance 3, Observation 2, Inspiration 2; Physical Toughness 1, Mental Toughness 2
stats_note: Draft: frail but sharp woman of 79. No stats for her in the scenario or its outline.
check: Speaking the name kills her within the year; never let her say it cheaply (lines 203-208, 453-457).

scenario: THE CURIOUS CASE OF MR PARKER'S DIARY
name: Pastor Elias Ström
essence: Wants the four children to have been carried.
where: The presbytery, Hällvattnet: Act One, and Act Two (Track A)

Has prayed about it for four years without telling anyone what about; ask him kindly
Helpfully suggests posting the diary on to someone else: he wants it out of his church
knows: Volunteers the lapsed Michaelmas rite at the old inlet; shows the 1893 gap in the registers

stats: Physique 3, Precision 2, Logic 3, Empathy 4; Inspiration 3, Learning 2, Observation 2; Physical Toughness 2, Mental Toughness 2

name: Aaron Teale
essence: Wants someone else to know. Cooperative, unrepentant, grieving a brother he never met.
where: Freight depot, Vernon, near the end of Act Two; then in custody
play: Does not resist, does not run, almost relieved; quiet and cooperative. Nobody shouts
Will not say sorry, as it comes out a lie; asks them only to know, not to do anything
Right that somebody should know, wrong about all else: not a crank, and not vindicated
knows: Hands over the torn ledger page unasked: H3-A, thirty-one living names
Human; twin Daniel died at four months, 1997. Asked Sang twice; remembers nine of the names
stats: STR C, AGI C, INT B, EMP C; Observation C, Connections C, Driving C, Hand-to-Hand Combat D; Health 4, Resolve 5

If tested, he puts his arm out without being asked
Decorated; pulled nine people out of the Sector 9 fire in 2035 and has the burns
knows: With Adeyemi: a man came asking questions in the spring, half of Teale's identity (automatic)
Alibi almost good enough; a replicant on Sang's ledger who did not kill her

name: Hollis Yeardley
essence: Eight summers; has read the log and said nothing.
wants: Someone to make him say it

He has seen this before and says so flatly, once.
He cannot run (MOV 4), so he chooses a room and stays in it.

Holds her line that this is kids and beer for as long as she can.

name: Witch Finder Garratt
essence: Wants one name off his ledger, and will not accept a private absolution. Unhurried, courteous, shares method and never conclusion.
wants: Anne Suddaby cleared, publicly, on the record, before a magistrate
where: Rides into Skelthwaite with the Agents; with them throughout; speaks at Sunday visitation
play: Unhurried, courteous, professional; shares method and never conclusion.
Never asks forgiveness; declines absolution courteously. Never repentant in a warm way.
Will not fight or resist the Agents. Money, threats and pleading do not move him.
knows: His ledger (H2-A): £4 6s for 1581 and who paid it. Points out the forgery in H2-B himself.
Asks once, in Act Two, what the meadowsweet meant. Ending 4 exists only if he is taught.
stats: Physicall d6, Intellectuall d10, Supernaturall d4. Hits 2. Abilities: Examination, Law. Will not fight.
stats_note: Drafted for an ageing professional examiner. Scenario gives no stats and says he will not fight.
check: Not confident of The Dee Sanction's printed NPC format; draft kept minimal, verify against the rulebook. Scenario wants no fight rolled.

name: Ezra Winterbourne
essence: Wants the rent paid before he dies, so his son never has to know. The parish's decency and its horror in one man.
wants: The offer accepted: the parish given the witch finder
where: His farm; comes to the Agents with the offer at the end of Act One; at the visitation
play: Frightened, not wicked; must not be played as wicked. He has rehearsed his speech.
He is sorry, and would be relieved to be thought a villain.
His offer is a real solution; do not undermine it. Accuses Garratt Sunday unless pre-empted.
knows: When he breaks: the Quiet Rent, the spoiled 1581 payment, why clearing Anne calls the debt in.
One of the eleven names on H2-D. Fallback: says revelations 7, 8, 9 and 12 in one speech.
stats: Physicall d4, Intellectuall d8, Supernaturall d6. Hits 1. Abilities: Parish Custom, Husbandry. Not a combatant.

name: Dr Albrecht Ritter
role: 51, Ahnenerbe scholar with the survey column
essence: Ahnenerbe scholar; wants to repair a two-century-old wrong, is correct about every fact, and is sincere.
wants: The restoration, Thursday at first light, done correctly
where: The camp in the barranco, from first contact in Act One; he invites the party in
play: Likeable, careful, sincere: not smug, not a fanatic, not secretly cruel.
Offers coffee, answers every question truthfully, shows the file unprompted. Has every fact.
Translates Fournel's note aloud and reads it as a formality. Keep him apart from Degen.
knows: Hands over the provenance file and 1932 export licence (H1). All genuine; there is no forgery.
Lets them read the 1811 requisition (H2/H3). Says the reliquary does nothing for its holder.
stats: No block of his own. With the column, one Enemy: Grit 8, Attack 2 Basic, Defense Critical. Alone (draft): Goon, Grit 3, Attack Basic, Defense Basic. Weak spot: a scholar, not a soldier.

check: Binding constraints: no uniforms or regalia as spectacle (field kit, clipboard); never a secretly good German. Lone-Ritter Enemy line is a draft.

name: Rosalía Benach
role: 74, villager of Sant Grau, Nuria's grandmother
essence: Wants the reliquary back in the niche, for the opposite reason to Ritter's, and will not explain herself twice.
wants: The lock shut: the reliquary back in the niche
where: Outside the church in Sant Grau, Act Two; at the niche at first light, Act Three
play: States it once and goes back to her beans; she does not argue and will not say it twice.
If Nuria is at the table she talks to her, not the party. Give that scene room.
At the niche she will not stop anybody and will not help. Never cut her.
knows: The niche is a fitting, a lock, open since 1811; the village has known since. She has no proof.
Fallback at 2:25: Fournel took it away for safety. Says revelations 8, 9, 10, 11 in one speech.
stats: No Enemy block: a 74-year-old villager who is never fought. If a roll to move her is wanted (draft): Critical difficulty, and she still will not argue back.
stats_note: Scenario gives no stats; she neither stops nor helps anyone (provenance.md 591-592). Difficulty drafted.
check: The scenario says never cut her (Act Two fallback). Suggested difficulty is a draft, not from the text.
